decision.completeness_basis: 'Programs' A-Z page of the 2026-2027 UF Undergraduate Catalog (prints 'All pages in 2026-2027 Academic Catalog'): 413 entries. Counted 129 major entries, one per list entry as the verified records are keyed. Award-split entries (Art BA/BFA, Dance, Music, Digital Arts and Sciences) and per-college entries (Biology, Botany, Computer Science, Marine Sciences, Microbiology and Cell Science, Interdisciplinary Studies) each count separately. Excluded: minors, certificates and all 'UF Online' entries (UF Online is a separate institution, ipeds-484473); 'Geography | Bachelor of Arts' (a UF Online sub-page); Music Performance Minor; 'Engineering | Exploring Engineering Studies' (no degree); and 'Pharmacy | Preprofessional'. Counted though unsure: the language entries that are Foreign Languages and Literatures or Hispanic and Latin American Languages concentration pages but are listed and keyed as their own programs, such as Dual Languages, Spanish, Portuguese, Spanish and Portuguese, Arabic and Chinese. The 89 verified records cover 87 of the 129. Astronomy and Astrophysics and Geography each hold 2 award records and count once. No records are for off-list programs, and none are matched through concentration records.
